title: Account-Standing Schedule for Late-Fee Reversals
content:
**Schedule.** On a Pre-K tuition account of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a late-fee reversal has an amount added when the tuition account shows arrears on the day the reversal is posted.

The whole months of arrears are the enrollment's tuition charges and late fees less its payments, divided by the most recent billing month's tuition charge and rounded down to a whole number. Credits are not payments and are not subtracted.

| Whole months of arrears on the day the reversal is posted | Added to the reversal |
|---|---|
| three or more | 5.00 |
| two | 2.50 |
| one or none | nothing |

## Worked cases (hypothetical enrollment, most recent tuition charge 360.00)

| Charges and late fees to date | Payments to date | Arrears divided by 360.00 | Whole months | Added |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1,900.00 | 700.00 | 3.33 | 3 | 5.00 |
| 1,900.00 | 1,000.00 | 2.5 | 2 | 2.50 |
| 1,900.00 | 1,250.00 | 1.81 | 1 | nothing |
